## Batch 38 authoring complete

Created the 11-item A page, three-example B page, synchronized manifest, source coverage, proof contracts, cross-batch records, and notes.

- [A page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/langevin-monte-carlo-mala-and-ula.md>)
- [B page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/langevin-monte-carlo-mala-and-ula-examples.md>)
- [Batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-38.notes.md>)
- [Coverage and fetch stamps](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-38.coverage.json>)
- [Proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-38.proof-contracts.json>)

Ten items have hash-current `ready` records; four are `escalated`: the quantitative ULA theorem, MALA’s algorithm and invariance theorem, and the dependent MALA example. The quantitative theorem retains the source’s full claim, but lacks local proofs for diffusion weighted ergodicity, the Girsanov pathwise KL bound, and Euler small-set/drift ergodicity. MALA also needs the batch-6 Euclidean standard-Borel lemma, whose draft proof was inspected but has no Step 1 record and is outside the declared page requirements. I recorded both issues for owner reconciliation.

Scoped dependency, content-policy, rendering, coverage, source-fetch, and strict proof-contract checks reported no errors. The 13 locally completed items passed proof-layout and phase precheck. The full 14-item proof-layout/precheck each reports the intentionally unproved quantitative theorem; it remains unnumbered and escalated. Strict proof-contract validation has one nonfatal warning about the coercivity proof’s first step citing all five facts it uses.

The recomputed batch-38 schedule is level 3 with prerequisites 6, 23, and 33. The shared schedule artifact is stale and was left untouched. Run-wide checks also report unrelated inventory and dependency-label errors; the batch-38 items have no dependency-level errors. The latest read-only autopilot status showed 38/62 batches covered, nothing in flight, and existing unrelated blockers. No engine state or independent approval was changed.
